seeded_from: UN-ECE-R95 — side impact / MDB / door / passenger-compartment / REESS / RDC-PSPF-APF
UN-ECE-R94 — frontal impact / front-seat protection / REESS / safety-belt seating Annex 5
UN-ECE-R16 — safety-belts, anchorages, retractor/ELR, reminder, geometry of the belt assembly
UN-ECE-R129 — CRS (weak for body-in-white; kept only on general fallback)
_meta.notes: DESIGN_IMPLICATION component → regulatory concept → likely regulation map. Components are rarely named literally in UNECE text (e.g. B-pillar), so mappings go through concepts those parts must satisfy. likely_regulations prefer when indexed (retrieve_design_implication). production_approved=false until a passive-safety engineer signs off — this is domain knowledge, not auto-truth.
review_decisions: B-pillar → primarily R95 (side structure / intrusion / door retention / MDB / passenger compartment). R94 kept secondary for shared integrity/door language, not as primary side-structure owner.
Seat-belt geometry → R16 owns belt/anchorage/geometry-of-assembly; R94/R95 constrain restraint of the dummy in crash. Aliases expanded to bare 'seat belt' / 'safety-belt' (longest-alias match).
Driver's seat → seating procedure + adjustment in R94/R95; R16 for belt/anchorage interaction. UN R17 seat strength often not indexed — noted, not invented as a retrieval target.
Side door overlaps B-pillar load path; kept separate for door-specific asks.
REESS mounting → R94/R95 electrical safety / retention / electrolyte (indexed).
vehicle_design_general is fallback only when no named component matches.
